336:t_014:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that's nice. A young man with some drive.」

336:t_014:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then let's go, $$サイデリアル$$! I fight for world peace and money!」

336:t_015:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, fall back at once! We're leaving this area before $$ストラウス$$ arrives!」

336:t_015:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...Looks like we were a little late.」

336:t_016:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Tch! To think I couldn't wipe out the enemy before Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ arrived...!」

336:t_017:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, fall back at once! We're leaving this area before $$ストラウス$$ arrives!」

336:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...Looks like we were a little late.」

336:t_018:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This feeling...! A $$スフィア・リアクター$$!」

336:t_018:1.en:
$n
「It's not just the $$欲深な金牛$$! That thing has...!」

336:t_018:3.en:
$n
「Emperor $$アウストラリス$$...! Is he aboard too?!」

336:t_018:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That man... he's looking at me...?」

336:t_018:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...$$揺れる天秤$$... I needn't even have bothered taking an interest.」

336:t_019:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アウストラリス$$! Did you come out yourself just to finish us off?!」

336:t_019:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Two Reactors and the $$特異点$$...! Is that what he's after?!」

336:t_020:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is warping...!」

336:t_020:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, disengage! At this rate a $$時空震動$$ will occur?!」

336:t_020:5.en:
$$桂$$
「This is... different from any $$時空震動$$ so far!」

336:t_020:7.en:
$n
「This feeling... it's the same as it was in $$第２新東京市$$...!」

336:t_023:1.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...I don't know either...」

336:t_023:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What on earth is happening...」

336:t_024:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Heh heh... After this, I can't say a word about $$ギルター$$.」

336:t_024:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah, but everyone, it is a fact that the $$サイデリアル$$ besides me are elite units, so no offense meant on that point.」

336:t_025:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like you've got a history with that guy too.」

336:t_025:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sort of. ...Want to hear the tale of my adventures on $$翠の地球$$?」

336:t_025:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't just go quiet on me!」

336:t_025:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$デュオ$$. Right now I've got no room in my heart or in my wallet.」

336:t_025:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Not just right now. It's always.」

336:t_025:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Anyway, let's go! Life has its ups and downs!」

336:t_025:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Your downs are way too deep, every single time.」

336:t_026:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A disgrace...! To be unable to stand on the same battlefield as the Supreme Commander!」

336:t_026:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But now I have a new pleasure! Being able to fight you, stronger than before, makes me the happiest man in the galaxy!」

336:t_027:1.en:
$$桂$$
「The type who thinks with his muscles... Personally, I don't dislike it.」

336:t_028:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Nice teamwork. That's the kind you only get from going through some serious hell.」

336:t_028:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Not that it's anything to be happy about.」

336:t_028:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But from here on, we have to fight the Empire's massive forces with only a small force.」

336:t_028:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「What turns around a disadvantage that neither strategy nor tactics can handle is nothing but each person's willpower...!」

336:t_028:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「We'll piece those together and keep fighting...!」

336:t_100:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$エスター$$... I half sensed it, but something happened to you, didn't it...)

336:t_100:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(But I believe... Even after becoming a $$次元獣$$, you turned human again...!)

336:t_100:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(I believe we'll meet again this time too...! So I'll do my best too!)

336:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've been looking for you, Mr. $$特異点$$. The $$新地球皇国$$ would like to welcome you.」

336:t_101:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know why you want me, but I'm not about to be an accomplice to invaders.」

336:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Even with 100 beauties thrown in?」

336:t_101:3.en:
$$桂$$
「I see... You've done a little research on me, but it's not enough, is it?」

336:t_101:5.en:
$$桂$$
「The only one I want in this whole multiverse is that one girl! I'm not lending a hand to anyone who can't understand that!」

336:t_101:6.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$, you are so cool!!」

336:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Good, good, $$桂木桂$$! More than as the $$特異点$$, you entertain me as a warrior!」

336:t_102:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, but I have no hobby of pleasing men...! Kindly make your exit right away!」

336:t_102:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Playing the lightweight with your mouth while shrewdly aiming for the bridge, the eyes of that warrior...! As expected, you are first-rate!」

336:t_102:3.en:
$$桂$$
「What an annoying approach! The only thing to do is shut him up fast!」

336:t_103:0.en:
$$桂$$
(Looks like there's no $$エマーン$$ in the $$翠の地球$$ either...)

336:t_103:1.en:
$$桂$$
(But I won't give up... If $$ミムジィ$$ exists in some world, I'll survive until the day I reach her...!)

336:t_103:2.en:
$$桂$$
(Where am I going, and when can I go home... I don't know the answers, but I'll definitely go back to where $$ミムジィ$$ is!)

336:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Whew, back when we fought together I never quite got a feel for it, but you really are an outrageous miser, aren't you, $$クロウ$$.」

336:t_104:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Better than you, hiding your true colors and sneaking in among us.」

336:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You think so? I'm always like this, you know. It's your rating that's gone negative, $$クロウ$$.」

336:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$クラヴィア$$ would be disillusioned if she heard.」

336:t_104:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't you dare brazenly bring up $$クラヴィア$$'s name.」

336:t_104:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...That killing intent... Looks like I've made you serious.」
